interpretation: All supplied representation cases and allocated slots are retained; unavailable baselines are not evaluated optimization failures.

Source aggregates use only the first protocol case per source SHA and give each byte-unique source equal weight; repetitions and functionally equivalent encodings do not increase the number of independent circuits.
Means use observed usable outcomes; missing/failed observations are not zero improvements. Coverage and denominators are reported alongside means.
LLM proposes moves; deterministic routing, phase repair, mapping and validation execute every policy. Do not attribute control gains to the LLM.
Compare backends only within their fixed clock family. This is descriptive small-circuit evidence, not physical waveform or power signoff.
